name: Sonohigurashi Sanmon
source:
The owner of 'Rasu-tei', an antiques shop situated on a street corner in the second district. He is a witness to the incident.
He was hunting for a lost Hoei-era gold koban coin at the time of the incident.

[Edited from in-game profile]
